title: 8 商人之死9 修血肉10 肉铺生意
slug: 在诡异世界变成蜘蛛精
content_zh:
：佛骨魔蛛一族的制香需要用到很多只有他们一族才知道的材料与办法，很多更是要以蜘蛛之躯才能完成。
贺堪伸手将自己顺滑的黑色长发揉的一团糟，决定这些事情之后再说，他现在肚子有些饿了，先填饱肚子吧。
“嗯？”
贺堪一推开门，正好就遇上回来的谢平平，机灵少年穿着长袍，手中提着符箓，一脸疲惫的样子，显然是刚刚从儒子阁下值。
谢平平也看见贺堪了，他立刻招呼道：“我记得你，邹老大把你送到我这了啊，看来是准备接下来都跟着我走。”
“什么意思？”
谢平平这个人自来熟是真的自来熟，少年的外表不妨碍他处事十分老道，情商也很高，相处起来不尴尬，贺堪起码觉得挺舒服的，听见谢平平这话，他嗯了一声，尾调轻轻拉长。
出了门，贺堪这才走到院子的石桌旁。
贺堪这个时候才看清楚石桌上面摆了一点买来的酒菜。
“意思就是之后很长一段时间，咱俩就是搭档，不出意外的话。”
谢平平开口解释，看贺堪有些拘束的样子，他还直接开口招呼：“没事，特地买就是为了一起吃的。”
贺堪也不拘束，以后都是一个院子住的了，根据谢平平的话，应该在仪征司这段时间，他都跟他处于搭档然后出任务，诡物不是好对付的，危机时候，自然要看队友情有几分。
“你现在白游了？”
吃到一半，谢平平迫不及待的开口询问道，其实谢平平在贺堪一开门的时候就发现了，废话，他也是从白游级升上来的，白游级什么样子他不清楚？
这个看上去温和好欺负的高挑青年周围气势一看就是刚升入白游级不久。
果然跟邹老大说的情况一样，这人天赋很不错。
“嗯，多了一点手段。”
贺堪吃了一会儿酒菜，没喝酒，因为上辈子都是未成年蜘蛛的原因，贺堪已经好久没喝酒了，主要就是吃菜，加上今天差不多一天没吃东西，饿的难受，吃了好一会儿，贺堪这才缓过来，才有心思回复谢平平的话。
考虑到未来的队友关系，贺堪还透露了一点自己白游级的手段。
谢平平满意的点点头：“看来你观想的很不错。”

“那接下来的这个任务你可以和我一起做了，做完之后，正好当入仪征司的考验，成功就跟老大拿行牌，到时候领的薪银也多点。”
谢平平一开始不想带贺堪的，主要是新人做任务，如果等级不够贸然参加任务死的话，到时候惨的也是他。
可现在，这新人不是白游级了吗？
李司士也说过这人天赋有点古怪。
贺堪听了这话，抬眸看了一眼谢平平，发现这人说话一脸认真，不像是开玩笑，监天司行牌他知道，李司士之前帮他们这批新人检测的时候说话行牌是个好东西，代表新人正式入职监天司。
正式工与实习工自然有差别。
“说说看。”
贺堪放下筷子，语气平缓的说道。
谢平平就知道这人肯定感兴趣，谁不喜欢银子呢，他迫不及待的就开口说道：“这任务也是我死缠烂打要过来的，是城西的一户商户，家里主事的男人经常外出经商，时不时再回家，也平安无事。”
“不久前，这男人回到家中，一切都很正常，没成想，这男人妻子在发现枕边人的不对，她偶然一次半夜苏醒，竟然听见枕边的丈夫嘴里吃东西的声音，似乎是皮膜夹杂着肉，据她所说，那声音十分瘆人，然而，等她第二天醒过来的时候，什么都没有，那床上东西都干净如初。”
“是否是幻听？”

: The Buddha Bone Demon Spider clan's incense making requires the use of many materials and methods that only their clan knows, and many of them can only be completed with the body of a spider.
He Kan reached out and rubbed his smooth black hair into a mess. He decided to talk about these things later. He was a little hungry now, so he should fill his stomach first.
"Huh?"
As soon as He Kan opened the door, he happened to meet Xie Pingping who had returned. The smart young man was wearing a long robe and holding a talisman in his hand. He looked tired. He had obviously just returned from his duties as a Confucian scholar.
Xie Pingping also saw He Kan, and he immediately greeted him: "I remember you. Boss Zou sent you to my place. It seems that you are planning to follow me from now on."
"What do you mean?"
Xie Pingping is a very familiar person. His youthful appearance does not prevent him from being very sophisticated in dealing with things, and his emotional intelligence is also very high. It is not awkward to get along with him. He Kan at least feels quite comfortable. When he heard Xie Pingping's words, he hummed, and the ending tone was slightly prolonged.
After leaving the door, He Kan walked to the stone table in the yard.
Only then did He Kan clearly see that there were some purchased wine and vegetables on the stone table.
"It means that we will be partners for a long time from now on, if nothing else happens."
Xie Pingping opened his mouth to explain. Seeing that He Kan looked a little restrained, he directly greeted him: "It's okay. I bought it specifically to eat together."
He Kan was not restrained. He would live in the same compound from now on. According to Xie Pingping, he should have been partnering with him during his time in the Yizheng Division before going on missions. Monsters are not easy to deal with. In times of crisis, it naturally depends on the level of friendship between teammates.
"Are you wandering for free now?"
Halfway through eating, Xie Pingping couldn't wait to ask. In fact, Xie Pingping discovered it when He Kan opened the door. Nonsense, he was also promoted from the Baiyou level. He didn't know what the Baiyou level was like?
This tall young man who looks gentle and easy to bully looks like he has just been promoted to Baiyou level.
As expected, the situation is the same as what Boss Zou said. This man is very talented.
"Well, there are a few more tricks."
He Kan ate food and wine for a while, but didn't drink. Because he was an underage spider in his previous life, He Kan hadn't drank for a long time. He mainly ate vegetables, and he hadn't eaten for almost a day today, so he felt hungry. After eating for a while, He Kan calmed down and was able to reply to Xie Pingping's words.
Considering his future relationship with teammates, He Kan also revealed some of his Baiyu-level methods.
Xie Pingping nodded with satisfaction: "It seems that your visualization is very good."
"Then you can do the next task with me. After you complete it, it will be the test for joining the Yizheng Division. If you succeed, you will get a business card from the boss, and you will receive more salary."
Xie Pingping didn't want to take He Kan with him at first, because it was mainly for newcomers to do missions. If he didn't have enough level to join the mission and died, he would be the one who would suffer.
But now, isn't this newcomer at the Baiyou level?
Li Sishi also said that this man's talent was a little weird.
After hearing this, He Kan raised his eyes and glanced at Xie Pingping, and found that this man spoke seriously, not like he was joking. He knew that Supervisor Tiansi Xingpai was a good thing when Li Sishi helped them test the new batch of people, which meant that the newcomers had officially joined Supervisor Tiansi.
There are natural differences between regular workers and interns.
"Tell me about it."
He Kan put down his chopsticks and said calmly.
Xie Pingping knew that this person must be interested. Who doesn't like money? He couldn't wait to speak and said: "This task is also what I have been stalking for. It is a merchant in the west of the city. The man in charge of the family often goes out to do business. He comes home from time to time and everything is fine."
"Not long ago, this man came home and everything was normal. Unexpectedly, this man's wife noticed something was wrong with the person next to her. She accidentally woke up in the middle of the night and heard the sound of her husband eating. It seemed thatIt was skin mixed with flesh. According to her, the sound was very scary. However, when she woke up the next day, there was nothing there, and everything on the bed was as clean as ever. "
"Is it a hallucination? "
